title: Isaiah 11:12 — God gathers the dispersed of Israel and Judah
summary: Isaiah 11:12 in English with the Hebrew reference: He will set up a banner for the nations and gather the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth. A few letters in Israel and Judah are coloured.

text.text: 12 He will set up a banner for the nations, And will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
